hints.title: Coordinate System Assignment
hints.text: Assign coordinates (row, col) to each node with root at (0, 0), left child at (row + 1, col - 1), and right child at (row + 1, col + 1).

hints.title: Vertical Order Sorting Priorities
hints.text: Sort all nodes primarily by column ascending, secondarily by row ascending, and tertiarily by node value ascending.

hints.title: Traverse and Group by Column
hints.text: Collect tuples (col, row, val) during traversal. Sort all collected tuples. Group nodes by column and extract lists of values in order.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def verticalTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> list[list[int]]:
        nodes = []
        def dfs(node: Optional[TreeNode], r: int, c: int):
            if not node:
                return
            nodes.append((c, r, node.val))
            dfs(node.left, r + 1, c - 1)
            dfs(node.right, r + 1, c + 1)
        dfs(root, 0, 0)
        nodes.sort()
        res = []
        last_c = None
        for c, r, val in nodes:
            if c != last_c:
                res.append([])
                last_c = c
            res[-1].append(val)
        return res
```

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard level-order traversal alone does not sort nodes sharing identical (row, col) coordinates by value.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the collected N node tuples takes O(N log N) time and linear O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note all 3 sorting keys: col (left to right), row (top to bottom), and val (value tiebreaker).
complexity.notes: Group contiguous elements with the same column coordinate together in the final answer.
